inputs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A 10-second cinematic LIVE-ACTION martial-arts fight, one uninterrupted medium-wide three-quarter side shot. Use the EXACT real adult actors, faces, hair, practical costumes, skin and fabric detail, warm daylight and rocky canyon of the attached image. Goku is the orange-and-blue man initially LEFT; Vegeta is the shorter navy/white/ochre armored man initially RIGHT. Vegeta's brown tail stays wrapped around his waist. Both full bodies and boots remain visible. Preserve the photographic image quality throughout the motion.

DIRECT THE FIGHT AS THREE CAUSAL EXCHANGES, with changing initiative and continuous pursuit. Six distinct compact strikes, brisk normal speed, no idle bouncing between them.

0-3 seconds: VEGETA TAKES SPACE. He completes the opening RIGHT straight into Goku's raised LEFT forearm. The block knocks Goku's shoulder and hips backward into a catching step. Vegeta immediately follows that retreat with his feet and rotates his hips into a short LEFT hook under Goku's guarding elbow, striking the upper abdomen. The glove touches and snaps back. AFTER contact Goku's trunk folds and his pelvis travels backward; he loses his original stance and takes two quick separate recovery steps. Vegeta advances into the space he gives up.

3-6.5 seconds: GOKU REVERSES THE PRESSURE. Goku plants his rear boot to stop the retreat and drives a compact RIGHT straight into Vegeta's cheek/upper guard. The fist immediately withdraws; Vegeta's head, shoulders and hips recoil together and a backward step catches his weight. Goku follows, plants his RIGHT support boot and snaps a LEFT front kick into the armored torso. Brief sole-to-armor contact, immediate knee recoil and foot landing. Vegeta is pushed bodily backward and must take two hurried catching steps; his guard is disrupted.

6.5-10 seconds: VEGETA BREAKS THE PURSUIT. Vegeta catches his weight, plants and pivots his LEFT boot, and whips his RIGHT shin into the OUTSIDE OF GOKU'S FORWARD THIGH, below the hip, never into the crotch or abdomen. After contact Goku's struck knee yields and his pelvis drops sideways; his other foot takes a lateral catching step. Vegeta retracts and replants his right leg, then follows with a short LEFT straight into Goku's recovering upper guard. The ending continues Vegeta's pressure and Goku's forced recovery, not a reset or a held victory pose.

Each strike is a quick out-and-back action. The attacking limb separates while the receiver continues moving from the impulse. Show mass through displaced shoulders AND pelvis, lost balance, bent knees, and distinct lifted-and-landed footsteps. No glued hands, sustained pushing, held kicking legs, sliding as a rigid body, floating boots or exaggerated drunken swaying. Defenders react and attempt to protect themselves; they never wait posed for the next strike. Camera tracks the physical retreat smoothly, without orbiting, cutting, shaking or flashing to hide contact. No powers, transformations, blood, extra people or text. Sound only: concise impacts, footfalls, cloth and light canyon wind. No speech, vocalizations, grunts or music.

overall_soundscape: Concise synchronized impacts, separate footfalls, cloth and light canyon wind. No speech, vocalizations, grunts or music.

non_diegetic_music: None.
